title: BRElections.jl: a Julia interface to Brazilian electoral open data (TSE)
description:
BRElections.jl gives typed access from Julia to the public electoral data published by Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE): candidates, candidate and party votes, vote details, polling-station results, declared assets, coalitions, vacancies, voter profiles, polling places with coordinates, cassation reasons and campaign finance (revenue and expenses of candidates and parties) from the TSE's open-data CDN, one or several years and states per call. Every table records its provenance (source file, the TSE version and download date), from which the package writes references for the data in ABNT, APA or BibTeX. It also reads live vote counting from the TSE's results system on election night, and provides a crosswalk between TSE and IBGE municipality codes.

The package handles the mechanics that stand between the published files and a usable table: downloads with retries, exponential backoff and atomic writes; a portable local cache built on Scratch.jl and revalidated against the TSE, which republishes files without changing their URLs; streaming ZIP extraction with ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8 transcoding in constant memory; multithreaded CSV reading with column selection and row filtering applied during import; and type conversion tuned to TSE conventions, with money columns read whatever the decimal separator and identifier columns kept as String so leading zeros survive.

It uses only files that are openly published, with no private API or authorisation. The data belongs to the TSE; this is an independent open-source client with no official affiliation to, or endorsement from, the TSE.
